title: Why Do You Get The Urge To Scratch?
hook: Why do you suddenly itch when others scratch?

narration.text: Seeing someone scratch an itch often makes you feel itchy too.
This is a form of social mimicry, a natural human response.
Your brain's mirror neurons activate, processing their action as if it were your own.
It is an automatic, unconscious imitation of their behaviour.
This empathy helps us connect and understand each other better.
Notice it next time you see someone else itching.
Try it right now and tell me if it worked on you in the comments, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more mind hacks.

description: Ever wondered why you start itching when you see someone else scratch? It is a fascinating example of social mimicry and how our brains are wired for empathy. This video explains the science behind this common, unconscious phenomenon.
topic: Why you get the urge to scratch when you see someone else scratching. This is a common social mimicry.
